name: @codegen-x/prototypes
description: Prototypes of the simple line: the clean organisms of packages/compose-gen projected onto wireframes, rectangles only (src/project.ts), their shapes, contracts and content models. Writes out/ (Svelte 5 + contracts + models + manifest), which ui8kit/prototypes syncs by commit (codegen.lock.json). Depends on compose-gen, never the reverse.

scripts.check: bun src/driver.ts --check && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && svelte-check --tsconfig tsconfig.svelte.json --fail-on-warnings
